# Ambi's eye: what they refused and what they leaned toward

Working document. Subject to change through continued conversation. Same law as AMBI-EAR.md: a judge is trusted only after it refuses every row of "Refused", unprompted, planted among good frames. The lead praised the first row (24 Nov 23:02); the lead's eye alone passes nothing.

| When | What | Their words | What it means for a builder |
|---|---|---|---|
| 24 Nov 23:17 | Refused: the McDonald's dot strip (`runs/hero/first-look-strip-4.jpg`): flat chalk dots on a plain ground, icon shapes (burger, house, pot), big stencil numbers, scribbled rings | "that mc donalds video is the worst looking thing ive ever seen. lean into our strengths in terms of design systems our software biases towards and uses as options" | No clip-art shapes, no dots standing for things on an empty flat ground, no infographic. The picture is made of real material in real light. New worlds are not invented while the worlds we have are stronger. |
| 24 Nov 23:24 | Why it was refused, in full | "well the galactic empires vid can do more its just the burger thing looked nothing like it whatsoever, in no way at all, derived. so it went very very left with novtrace." | The hero film teaches its LOOK and its thinking. A design system that claims to grow from it carries a trace: each trait (ground, territory, label, extrusion, camera, edit, count, reuse, framing of footage) with the second of the hero it was measured at, and what was kept or bent. A stranger shown both must say "these are family". Its exact drawings, colours together, names, franchise clips and subject are not copied. Nothing is drawn before the film has been taken apart shot by shot. |

Our strengths, seen on 24 Nov by the lead in `mockups/show/engine-stages-5.jpg`, `looks-six.jpg`, `runs/engines/clipspace-sheet.jpg` (a candidate reading, Ambi's eye decides): map theatre (dark sea, textured land, lit coast, frontiers that burn), scale flight and route chart (real planets and the Milky Way behind), instrument view (porthole and dials), paintings shown flat and whole (ADR 0014.9: no parallax cut-outs, no fake depth), document page with a real bust, archive footage, lineage tree with real portraits, telegrams between real faces. What they share: real sourced material, depth, one light, quiet serif or instrument type, a date and one number in the corner, dark grounds.

The law that was broken: ADR 0014 point 6 (ink navy, charcoal, cream; heavy numbers; no toy grounds), 9 (flat planes drawn perfectly, nothing fragile), 12, 13 (two looks: A dark navy and cream essay from ZgpMtombn9A; B crisp telemetry and map from Milky Stellar and Atticus King). Read it before drawing anything.
